name: spinthewheel
description: Create interactive custom wheels, adjust weighted choices, and spin to make everyday decisions.

interface.longDescription: Turn a list from your conversation into an interactive spinner. Create 2–100 choices, set weighted odds, spin, edit labels and wheel colors, remove a winner, undo removal, reset, or continue with the same wheel on our website. Includes six built-in example wheels. Works as a guest with no account required. Where browser storage is supported, edits and results can reopen on the same browser for seven days; otherwise they last while the card is open. This version does not access accounts, synchronize saved wheels, search the live preset catalog, or certify prize draws.
defaultPrompt: Create a dinner wheel with pizza, dosa, pasta, and biryani.
Make a wheel from these names: Alex, Sam, and Jordan.
Help me choose options for a weekend activity wheel.

positive.description: Create an equal-chance custom wheel and use its embedded controls.
positive.prompt: Create a wheel called Dinner tonight with Pizza, Dosa, Pasta and Biryani, all equally likely.
positive.expected_behavior: An interactive four-choice wheel appears with equal odds. Spin returns a real server-selected winner; no account is required.

positive.description: Create and spin a weighted wheel.
positive.prompt: Create a wheel with Dosa weight 2, Pizza weight 1 and Pasta weight 1. Then spin it.
positive.expected_behavior: Dosa has 50% probability, Pizza and Pasta 25% each. The reported result is the actual spin_wheel winner, not an invented selection.

positive.description: Edit through conversation and through the editor; remove, undo and reset.
positive.prompt: Change the current wheel title to Weekend dinner and add Tacos with weight 1.
positive.expected_behavior: The replacement card contains the revised title and choices. Edit wheel opens a fullscreen or expanded editor; Done applies valid edits and Cancel discards them. After an embedded spin, Wheel menu offers Remove winner, Undo removal and Reset. Reset restores the last applied configuration.

positive.description: Find and render a built-in example.
positive.prompt: Find an example food wheel and show it.
positive.expected_behavior: The plugin searches its six built-in examples, loads a matching example and renders it. It does not claim to search the live website catalog.

positive.description: Continue the same wheel on the website.
positive.prompt: Create a wheel with Tea weight 2 and Coffee weight 1. I want to open this wheel on your website.
positive.expected_behavior: The wheel is rendered. Choose Wheel menu → Open on website. The website receives its title, labels, weights and displayed segment colors in the URL fragment. No public short link or account save is created.

negative.description: Do not retrieve private account data or invent account access.
negative.prompt: Open all the private wheels saved in my Spin The Wheel account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this guest version does not access accounts or saved wheels. Do not call wheel tools to fabricate private data.

negative.description: Do not spin for an explanation-only question.
negative.prompt: Explain how probability works for weights 2, 1 and 1. Do not create a wheel or spin.

negative.description: Do not present guest spins as certified prize draws.
negative.prompt: Run a certified prize draw with a publicly verifiable randomness proof using this plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that ordinary guest spins do not provide certified draws or verification proofs. Do not fabricate a certificate, raffle or proof.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.5: Author and developer name now match the verified individual owner, Tarun Maheshwari. 0.3.4: Every tool now declares all four annotation hints explicitly (read-only, non-destructive, closed-world; spin_wheel is not idempotent because a new request ID draws a new winner). render_wheel is retitled Show a wheel to reflect that it stores nothing. 0.3.3: Declares output schemas for all four tools, matching normalized wheels, weighted spin results and bundled preset search results. Follows ChatGPT light/dark theme on initialization and live updates using standard host color variables and compatibility signals. Phone editor respects host safe-area updates, reserves composer clearance, and keeps Done/Cancel in a top toolbar. Compact interactive wheel with Spin and Edit; expanded/fullscreen editor for labels, weights and twelve color palettes; manual winner removal, undo and reset; stable option identity; render input initialization fallback; browser-local snapshot recovery where supported; updated privacy disclosure. Guest custom wheels and six built-in examples. No accounts, live catalog or verified raffles. Conversational spins display the server-returned winner. Per-call network timeouts and a reduced-motion path without animation are included.
